factory_observability.title: Factory Helper
factory_observability.container.tip: Record this container's visible contents and open the helper.
factory_observability.help.title: Three easy steps
factory_observability.help.step2: 2. Click "View contents" at the top left
factory_observability.help.step3: 3. Pick a box and see its items and amounts
factory_observability.help.body1: Open a container as usual. No setup is needed.
factory_observability.help.body2: The helper captures its contents before opening your records. No timed wait is needed.
factory_observability.help.body3: Optional: pick an item, mark its destination, then choose another box. You can skip this.
factory_observability.help.shortcut: Press %s in game to open. Records last for this game session.
factory_observability.filter.none: No match. Try an item name or clear the search.
factory_observability.sort.tip: Switch between recent records and item amounts.
factory_observability.empty.title: No box records yet. Try this:
factory_observability.items.empty:
Walk near items on the ground to record them.
These are kept separate from box contents.
factory_observability.item.choose: Select this item to mark where it should go.
factory_observability.item.variant: This named or component-bearing item is counted separately. Click to select.
factory_observability.rename.title: Name this box record
factory_observability.rename.hint: For example: Furnace input or Ore buffer
factory_observability.link.tip: Next, choose a destination box. This is a note; it does not move items.
factory_observability.link.select_item: Select an item above, then choose its destination box.
factory_observability.link.title: Where should this item go?
factory_observability.link.choose: Step 2: pick a destination, then confirm below.
factory_observability.link.need_box: No other box is recorded yet. Open the destination box in game, then come back.
factory_observability.link.saved: Destination marked. You can remove it at any time.
factory_observability.link.unavailable: The records changed. Please choose again.
factory_observability.flow.empty:
No destinations marked yet.
Go to box records, pick an item, then mark its destination.
factory_observability.flow.hint: Your notes, not automatic transport. Click a record to inspect; × removes it.
factory_observability.info.title: About this record
factory_observability.info.menu: These are the items visible when the container was open. Closing it keeps the last result, without continuing to update.
factory_observability.info.entity: These items were visible nearby. Losing sight keeps their last amounts; their outcome is unknown.
factory_observability.info.waiting: No successful record yet. Try opening the container again.
factory_observability.info.partial: Only part of the contents was readable, so amounts may be incomplete.
factory_observability.info.observed: Amounts come from items that were visible. Unseen contents are not guessed.
factory_observability.info.refresh: Open a container again to leave a new record.
factory_observability.session.only: Session only. Closed boxes show their last record.
